top_signals.title: Fincantieri CEO Folgiero Honored
top_signals.summary: Pierroberto Folgiero, CEO and General Manager of Italian shipbuilding group Fincantieri, received the National Italian American Foundation's (NIAF) Dea Roma Special Achievement Award for Outstanding Leadership in Maritime Industry during the organization's 51st Anniversary Gala in Washington…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
